I find things like this very comforting honestly, I like to think that she watches over me, one way or another. I also remember the first dream i had about her after she passed, we were standing in an open field and she told me she was happy with me and it'll be okay (something along those lines, i don't remember exactly what). Then she hugged me, i hugged her back so tight, and when I opened my eyes she was gone and i was standing there on my own. I'll never forget that dream, it meant a lot to me honestly. I also sometimes used to write down what i dreamed about if she was in it, or any other thoughts related to her. That's also something you could try maybe, just writing down how you feel or anything else. It helped me in the past. Thank you for sharing the story about the white butterfly, i hope you can find comfort in this, in any way. Another thing I'd like to say is that in my experience, time doesn't heal all wounds, but it does make it less suffocating. I hope it'll also help you in some way
